bug_report_content:
id: 575
status: Fixed
summary: Original source line numbers are one-based in source maps.
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 0
commentCount: 6
Comment 0 (2011-10-11): Generated source line/column numbers and original column numbers are zero-based. Original source line numbers should be zero based as well.
Comment 1 (2011-10-12): @john: what does the spec say?
Comment 2 (2011-10-13): I assume this is a V3 source map encoding issue. Using the API the result should be 1 based, but the encoding should be 0 based (why waste a bit). We won't change the V1/V2 encoding. Pavel, can you update the v3 document with appropriate text? It doesn't indicate the starting index for the encoded source location.
Comment 3 (2011-10-13): Added "zero-based" to all segment fields definitions.
Comment 4 (2011-10-27): This is just an encoding problem it won't affect users of the common library.
Comment 5 (2011-11-15): This issue was closed by revision r1596.
